transforms.code:
color = 'var(--oee-status-good)'
	if value <= self.session.custom.launchpad.oee.target:
		color = 'var(--oee-status-bad)'
	
	return color

color = 'var(--oee-good)'
	if value <= self.session.custom.launchpad.oee.target:
		color = 'var(--oee-bad)'
	
	return color

# hide the label once its segment is too narrow to hold a glyph
	return 'A' if (1 - value) >= 0.08 else ''

# hide the label once its segment is too narrow to hold a glyph
	return 'P' if (1 - value) >= 0.08 else ''

# hide the label once its segment is too narrow to hold a glyph
	return 'Q' if (1 - value) >= 0.08 else ''

tooltip = "OEE: " + str(value.o) + "% " + "Availability: " + str(value.a) + "% " + "Performance: " + str(value.p) + "% " + "Quality:   " + str(value.q) + "%"
	return tooltip
